name: ktix
description: Save your ideas to ktix, get a short starter plan for each, and check on background research about similar products.

interface.shortDescription: Say an idea, get a plan back
interface.longDescription: ktix saves ideas you share in ChatGPT to your ktix account. When you save an idea, ktix returns a short starter plan: what it is, who it might be for, three possible first steps, and one open question. ktix then looks up similar products on the web in the background; ask about the idea later to see what it found, with source links. You can also plan a small test of an idea, record how the test went, and set each idea's status (exploring, trying, done, parked or dropped). Ask ktix to brainstorm to get a short menu of brainstorming templates. You can delete your ktix account and all saved ideas with the delete tool. Plans and research are generated by AI and may be incomplete or wrong.
defaultPrompt: I have an idea: a carpool app for parents at the same soccer club. Save it to ktix.
What did ktix find about my carpool idea?
